description: Run your smart home from a workflow: switch lights and devices, set levels, run scenes and scripts, read sensors and their history, and check which devices are offline. Start a workflow when an item changes, a reading passes a number, a device goes offline or openHAB finds a new one.

openhab_group_item_changed_trigger.description: Runs when any item in a group, or any item with a tag, changes state, such as any door opening or any light going on. It runs once for each item that changed.

output.groups: The groups it belongs to, by name

parameters.description: Watch the items in this group and the groups inside it: its name, such as Doors, or its label. Give a group, a tag or both.

openhab_item_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an item's state changes, such as a door opening or a light going on, only when it changes to a state you choose, or when a reading goes above or below a number, such as a temperature over 25.

output.changed_at: When it changed (UTC), when openHAB says
output.groups: The groups it belongs to, by name
output.label: The item's label, as people see it
output.link: Where the item opens in openHAB
output.name: The item's name, which other openHAB steps take
output.number: The state as a number, empty when it isn't one
output.previous_state: What it showed before, when openHAB says
output.state: What the item changed to, such as ON or 21.5 °C
output.type: What kind of item it is, such as Switch, Dimmer or Number
output.unit: The unit of that number, such as °C, or blank

parameters.description: The item to watch: its name, such as Front_Door, or its label.
parameters.name: item

parameters.description: Only when it changes to this state, such as ON, OPEN or 50. Leave blank for any change.
parameters.name: to_state

parameters.description: Only when its number goes above this, such as 25. It runs once each time the number is crossed.
parameters.name: above

parameters.description: Only when its number goes below this, such as 5. It runs once each time the number is crossed.

openhab_thing_discovered_trigger.description: Runs when openHAB finds a new device or service on the network and puts it in its inbox, such as to tell someone it is waiting to be added.

output.binding: The add-on that found it, such as hue
output.bridge: The ID of the bridge it was found through, or blank
output.ignored: Whether someone chose to ignore it
output.label: What openHAB calls what it found
output.properties: What was found out about it, such as its address
output.thing_type: What kind of thing it is
output.uid: The ID the thing would have

openhab_thing_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a thing (a device or service openHAB talks to) goes offline, such as a sensor with a flat battery, or comes back online, with why. A thing someone turned off doesn't count as offline.

output.bridge: The ID of the bridge it connects through, or blank
output.change: offline, online or other: what the thing became
output.enabled: Whether the thing is turned on in openHAB
output.label: The thing's label
output.link: Where the thing opens in openHAB
output.status: ONLINE, OFFLINE, UNINITIALIZED, INITIALIZING, UNKNOWN or REMOVING
output.status_description: Why, in the thing's own words, when it says
output.status_detail: Why, in openHAB's word, such as COMMUNICATION_ERROR or DISABLED; blank when there's nothing to say
output.thing_type: What kind of thing it is, such as astro:sun
output.uid: The thing's ID, which other openHAB steps take

parameters.description: offline (goes offline), online (comes back online) or any (either). Leave blank for offline.
parameters.name: change

parameters.description: Only this thing: its ID, such as hue:0210:bridge1:lamp3, or its label. Leave blank for every thing.
parameters.name: thing
